subject.title: v2026.4.25 regression: memory-core breaks agent by using wrong API key for embeddings

question: Should memory embeddings remain an explicitly configured independent provider, or should OpenClaw inherit the active chat provider only when it advertises a supported embedding capability?
rationale: Source establishes the current independent-provider behavior, but choosing automatic inheritance, mandatory setup, defaults, and upgrade handling changes provider and onboarding policy rather than repairing one mechanical defect.

options.title: Explicit setup and validation
options.body: Keep memory embeddings independent, require or strongly prompt provider selection during setup, validate credentials, and degrade visibly without blocking chat.

options.title: Capability-based inheritance
options.body: Inherit the chat provider only when its adapter explicitly declares embedding support, otherwise require an independent embedding provider.

options.title: Retain current behavior
options.body: Continue defaulting memory embeddings to OpenAI and address the problem through clearer documentation and diagnostics only.

recommendation.title: Explicit setup and validation
recommendation.body: Keep memory embeddings independent, require or strongly prompt provider selection during setup, validate credentials, and degrade visibly without blocking chat.

likelyOwner.reason: The memory architecture traces to this person's feature history, and the remaining choice affects core provider and onboarding policy.
